ownRead.statement:
### E05 — Prindle et al. (2015)

**Ion channels enable electrical communication in bacterial communities**  
Nature 527, 59–63. DOI: [10.1038/nature15709](https://doi.org/10.1038/nature15709)

**Classification:** supports core / domain-specific realization.  
**Evidence:** Experiment with interventions.  
**Existing clauses:** §3, §5, §7.

Potassium-mediated signals coordinate biofilm metabolic activity; potassium clamping suppresses the measured membrane-potential oscillations.

**Scope:** Bacillus subtilis biofilms under the reported growth conditions.

**Checked:** Primary publisher text and extended-data figure descriptions.  
**Location:** Electrical signalling mechanism; Extended Data Figure 3, potassium-clamp intervention.  
**Inspected source:** https://www.nature.com/articles/nature15709
